basis: September 5 supplied audit compared with pinned dev documentation; resolved means the cited wording is repaired, not live behavior certified.

prior_scope.method: Repository-tree inventory, main/dev comparison, targeted document reads and cross-checks against later accepted requirements, code, configuration and selected PR/deployment records through the GitHub connector.
limitations: This is a repository-wide discovery and targeted-content audit, not a certified line-by-line read of every tracked byte.
Large documents were read in relevant sections; not every historical paragraph was inspected.
Binary reference documents, every changelog entry, every generated UI snapshot, all vendored/plugin content, all historical branches and every Kanmer ticket document were not individually audited.
The kanmer-board branch was identified, but its complete ticket-document corpus was not audited.
No tests, builds, deployments, external integrations or live administrative operations were executed. Operational claims are attributed to the repository evidence rather than independently re-proved.
The list is the exact set of confirmed findings established in this review; it is not a guarantee that no additional stale material exists.
